title: AWS Global Router
description: An ephemeral, on demand multi-region WireGuard VPN orchestrator. Dynamically provisions disposable cloud gateways across global AWS regions with automated session self teardown, split-tunnel routing, DynamoDB parameter storage and real-time cost analytics.
Highlights: On-demand global WireGuard gateway orchestration across AWS regions via automated EC2 UserData bootstrapping
Multi-device mesh networking supporting up to 5 concurrent client keypairs per node (10.8.0.2 - 10.8.0.6) with interactive device management
Warm Standby (Sleep/Resume) lifecycle eliminating compute and public IPv4 charges while enabling rapid ~10s gateway resumption
Anonymous Dynamic DNS (DuckDNS) integration ensuring persistent client configs and hidden infrastructure footprint
Hardened REST control plane secured with API key authentication (X-API-Key) protecting mutating endpoints
Cloud-persisted configuration and real-time cost intelligence powered by AWS DynamoDB
Custom split-tunnel traffic routing with scannable QR code generation for instant mobile and desktop pairing
Zero-trust ingress architecture integrating Cloudflare Access tunnels with hardened single-port UDP security groups
